reason: Judge failed to give tangible weight to Gladue and systemic factors; appeal court reduced six years to four years.
No Gladue report was before sentencing judge; Crown conceded, fresh Gladue report accepted and sentence reduced.
Judge never expressly considered Indigenous background; with a math error, this required sentence reduction to 17 months.
Judge carefully reviewed Gladue report and applied systemic factors; appeal dismissed except victim surcharge set aside.
Majority struck down conditional sentence bar as discriminatory against Indigenous offenders; substituted time served. Constitutional ruling, not ordinary Gladue error.
